$comment: Canonical model for Events. Not fetched at runtime (no JavaScript); events.html mirrors these records as static HTML. Records with is_placeholder: true await confirmation.

fields.id: string (required, unique) — stable key, prefix 'evt-', zero-padded to three digits.
fields.title: string (required) — the event name as displayed.
fields.time: string (required) — local start and end time, West Africa Time (UTC+1).
fields.location: string (required) — venue as a display string.
fields.category: string (required) — one of: Milestone | Competition | Bootcamp | Hackathon | Research | Incubation.
fields.description: string (required) — two to three sentences on what happens at the event and who it is for.
fields.image_url: string (optional) — path, relative to the site root, of the event photograph. Omitted where the hub has no photograph for the event yet.
fields.image_alt: string (required) — alternative text written as though the real photograph were already in place.
fields.registration: string (required) — where to sign up, or a statement that registration is not required or is closed.
fields.is_placeholder: boolean (required) — true where the scheduling is illustrative and awaiting confirmation.
fields.note: string (optional) — present only where a specific detail needs verifying before publication.

events.title: C2P Tech Hub Launch
events.location: Department of Computer Engineering, First Floor, Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria
events.description: The formal opening of the hub, hosted by the Department of Computer Engineering. Staff, students and invited guests saw the space, the first project benches and the programme of work planned for the session. The first weekly coding sessions began the following week.
events.image_alt: Staff and students gathered in the newly opened C2P Tech Hub space on the first floor of the Computer Engineering building
events.registration: Closed - this event has taken place
events.note: Confirm the exact launch date with the department before publication.

events.title: Huawei ICT Competition - Innovation Track Finals
events.description: The national finals of the Huawei ICT Competition innovation track, where the ParaVision team presented their parasite detection tool to the judging panel and won the track. The team had been mentored at the hub through the preceding session.
events.image_alt: The ParaVision team on stage at the Huawei ICT Competition national finals, holding their innovation track winners' award
events.registration: Closed - this event has taken place
events.note: Confirm the exact finals date and venue with the team before publication.

events.title: Embedded Systems Bootcamp: Cohort 1
events.location: C2P Tech Hub, First Floor, Department of Computer Engineering
events.description: A three-week evening bootcamp taking members from bare-metal C to a working sensor node on the ESP32. Sessions are hands-on throughout and each participant defends a small working build in the final week. Boards are provided and shared between pairs.
events.image_alt: Students at a workbench wiring ESP32 development boards during an evening embedded systems bootcamp session
events.registration: Apply through the Join the Hub form

events.title: ABU Innovation Hackathon 2026
events.time: Opens 16:00 WAT Friday, judging 14:00 WAT Sunday
events.location: Department of Computer Engineering, Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria
events.description: A 48-hour build sprint against a problem brief published when the clock starts. Teams of three to five have until Sunday afternoon to produce something they can demonstrate live to a panel of departmental staff and visiting industry engineers. The strongest teams are fast-tracked into the next incubation cohort.
events.image_alt: Hackathon teams working through the night at long tables in the Computer Engineering building, laptops and whiteboards in use
events.registration: Team registration through the Join the Hub form

events.title: Research Seminar: Computer Vision in Diagnostics
events.location: Computer Engineering Seminar Room, First Floor
events.description: The computer vision research cluster presents its current work, using ParaVision as the worked example of how a diagnostic model moves from labelled dataset to something a clinician could use. Open to all members and to staff from across the faculty.
events.image_alt: A student presenting computer vision research to seated staff and members in the Computer Engineering seminar room
events.registration: Open to all members - no registration required

events.title: Incubation Cohort 1 Demo Day
events.location: Department of Computer Engineering, Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria
events.description: The closing event of the first incubation cohort, where all eight teams demonstrate what they built across the semester. Each team gets a fixed slot to show working software or hardware and answer questions from staff, industry guests and other members.
events.image_alt: An incubation team demonstrating their working prototype to staff and industry guests at Demo Day
